description_en: Queries the detailed progress of a node group configuration refresh task. Returns the actual execution result for each node, including refreshed properties, properties skipped because they exceeded the MaxDisruptiveAction constraint, and failure reasons
description_zh: 查询节点组配置刷新任务详细进展。返回每个节点的实际执行结果，包括已刷新的属性、因超出 MaxDisruptiveAction 约束被跳过的属性、以及失败原因
name: DescribeNodeGroupRefreshTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the refresh task
parameters.name: node_group_refresh_task_id

parameters.help_en:
The node refresh statuses to filter by. Valid values:
Pending: the node is waiting to be refreshed.
InProgress: the node is being refreshed.
Success: the node is refreshed.
Failed: the node failed to be refreshed.
Skipped: all properties to be refreshed on the node exceeded the MaxDisruptiveAction constraint and were skipped
parameters.help_zh:
查询要过滤的节点刷新状态：
Pending 节点等待刷新
InProgress 节点正在刷新
Success 节点刷新成功
Failed 节点刷新失败
Skipped 节点所有待刷新属性都超出MaxDisruptiveAction约束而跳过
parameters.name: node_statuses

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request. This parameter is used to paginate through the node list in the current refresh task
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的 NextToken 参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数。用来分页拉取当前刷新任务中的节点列表
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 100. For more information about paging, set the NextToken parameter
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数，取值范围：1~500。默认值：100
parameters.name: max_results

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the refresh task in ISO 8601 format

FinishedCount.description_en: The number of finished nodes, including successful, failed, and skipped nodes
FinishedCount.description_zh: 已完成节点数(包括成功、失败、跳过的)
FinishedCount.title_zh: 已完成节点数(包括成功、失败、跳过的)

MaxDisruptiveAction.description_en: The maximum disruptive action level allowed for the refresh operation
MaxDisruptiveAction.description_zh: 刷新操作允许的最大破坏性操作等级
MaxDisruptiveAction.title_zh: 刷新操作允许的最大破坏性操作等级

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 单页查询的最大条目数
MaxResults.title_zh: 单页查询的最大条目数。

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next query. An empty value of NextToken indicates that no more results exist
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的 Token，NextToken 为空表示没有下一个
NextToken.title_zh: 下一个查询开始的 Token，NextToken 为空表示没有下一个。

NodeGroupId.description_en: The ID of the node group

NodeGroupRefreshTaskId.description_en: The ID of the refresh task

Action.description_en:
The action level actually executed on the node. If multiple properties are refreshed on the node, the highest required action level is used. Valid values:
Refresh: in-place refresh.
Reboot: restart.
Reimage: reimage.
If the entire node is skipped, this value is empty
Action.description_zh:
对该节点实际执行的动作等级。若节点有多个属性被刷新，取其中所需动作等级最高者：
Refresh 原地刷新
Reboot 重启
Reimage 重装
若整个节点被跳过，返回空
Action.title_zh:
对该节点实际执行的最高动作等级。若节点有多个属性被刷新，取其中所需动作等级最高者：
Refresh 原地刷新
Reboot 重启
Reimage 重装
若整个节点被跳过，返回空。

MinRequiredAction.description_en: The minimum action required to apply the target value: Refresh, Reboot, or Reimage. For more information, refer to the MaxDisruptiveAction parameter description in the RefreshNodeGroupNodes operation

MinRequiredAction.title_zh: 使TargetValue生效所需的最低动作：Refresh / Reboot / Reimage，详情参见RefreshNodeGroupNodes接口入参MaxDisruptiveAction解释。
